legend: Arkady plays Gardenscapes a lot. Arkady wants to build two new fountains. There are n available fountains, for each fountain its beauty and cost are known. There are two types of money in the game: coins and diamonds, so each fountain cost can be either in coins or diamonds. No money changes between the types are allowed.
Help Arkady to find two fountains with maximum total beauty so that he can buy both at the same time.
input: The first line contains three integers n, c and d (2 ≤ n ≤ 100 000, 0 ≤ c, d ≤ 100 000) — the number of fountains, the number of coins and diamonds Arkady has.

The next n lines describe fountains. Each of these lines contain two integers bi and pi (1 ≤ bi, pi ≤ 100 000) — the beauty and the cost of the i-th fountain, and then a letter "C" or "D", describing in which type of money is the cost of fountain i: in coins or in diamonds, respectively.
output: Print the maximum total beauty of exactly two fountains Arkady can build. If he can't build two fountains, print 0.
note: In the first example Arkady should build the second fountain with beauty 4, which costs 3 coins. The first fountain he can't build because he don't have enough coins. Also Arkady should build the third fountain with beauty 5 which costs 6 diamonds. Thus the total beauty of built fountains is 9.
In the second example there are two fountains, but Arkady can't build both of them, because he needs 5 coins for the first fountain, and Arkady has only 4 coins.

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Arkady 应该建造第二座美观度为 4、花费 3 枚金币的喷泉。由于金币不足，他无法建造第一座喷泉。此外，Arkady 还应该建造第三座美观度为 5、花费 6 颗钻石的喷泉。因此，建造的喷泉总美观度为 9。
在第二个样例中有两个喷泉，但 Arkady 无法将它们全部建造出来，因为建造第一个喷泉需要 5 枚硬币，而 Arkady 只有 4 枚硬币。

legend.ai: Arkady 经常玩《Gardenscapes》。Arkady 想要建造两座新喷泉。现在有 n 座可供选择的喷泉，已知每座喷泉的美观度和花费。游戏中有两种货币：金币和钻石，因此每座喷泉的花费可能是金币或钻石。两种货币之间不能进行兑换。
请帮助 Arkady 找到总美观度最大的两座喷泉，使得他能够同时购买这两座喷泉。

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 n、c 和 d（2 ≤ n ≤ 100 000，0 ≤ c、d ≤ 100 000），分别表示喷泉的数量、Arkady 拥有的金币数量和钻石数量。
接下来 n 行描述喷泉。每行包含两个整数 bᵢ 和 pᵢ（1 ≤ bᵢ、pᵢ ≤ 100 000），分别表示第 i 座喷泉的美观度和花费，随后是一个字母 "C" 或 "D"，表示第 i 座喷泉的花费类型分别为金币或钻石。

output.ai: 输出 Arkady 能够建造的恰好两座喷泉的最大总美观度。如果他无法建造两座喷泉，则输出 0。
